chronological_split.description: Deterministic event-aware temporal split. TRAIN contains baseline pre-event days plus the first flood wave (Nov 15-17, 2015). VALIDATION contains the initial peak of the second flood episode (Nov 30 - Dec 02, 2015) with real positive observations for early stopping and threshold selection. TEST contains the subsequent catastrophic inundation and recession dates (Dec 03 - Dec 10, 2015) for one-time final evaluation. Intermediate recession dates (Nov 18-29) are EXCLUDED to prevent post-event transition leakage.
chronological_split.scientific_evaluation_limitation: The validation and test periods are portions of the same broader second flood episode. Therefore the evaluation represents forward-in-time extrapolation on a later phase of the second flood episode, and does NOT represent independent-event generalization to a completely unseen flood event.

spatial_overlap_disclosure.note: The same 3,963 grid cells occur across all temporal partitions. This is a temporal city-specific susceptibility setting, not an accidental duplication, but model performance is not being evaluated under strict spatial holdout.

south_block.description: South Chennai (Adyar Basin, OMR, Velachery, Sholinganallur)

central_block.description: Central Chennai (Cooum Basin, GCC Core, Anna Nagar, T. Nagar, Mylapore)

north_block.description: North Chennai (Kosasthalaiyar Basin, Madhavaram, Puzhal, Manali, Tondiarpet)
